notes.title: Bad Dream: Afterlife is coming soon !!!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45172409/0324f1660d558b8922e17968391737ed8d5dc8e0.png[/img]
Bad Dream: Afterlife is a return to the series' roots, and the beginning of a new era! Bad Dream: Purgatory concluded the storyline that had been going on since 2013 (it started with Bad Dream: Butcher). All the characters have a good ending, but life goes on. Unfortunately... It's naive to think that "happily ever after" is a realistic ending. Only the dead can't feel pain and sadness.

Once again it's time to fall asleep and experience the nightmare...

[u][b]Add Bad Dream: Afterlife to your wishlist and stay tuned![/b][/u]

[url]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3202410/Bad_Dream_Afterlife/[/url]

While waiting you can also play:
[url]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1692060/Bad_Dream_Stories/[/url]
[url]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2540460/Faded_Stories_Full_Moon/[/url]

notes.title: About reviews
notes.notes:
Not gonna lie... I have some bad reviews. But I also have lovely ones. I know it's not a typical BD game, but I really wanted to make this part. Story in this game is very personal, that's why I appreciate your support so much <3

I know that after we released Coma people expected something bigger. But Coma was waaaaaaay beyond our reach. Developing this game broke me mentally and It was very unprofitable for our team. The whole project was simply too ambitious for us. 

That's why we were forced to make something smaller.

And I know that not everyone like Fever... Trust me, I saw reviews xD But that's ok. I'm not here to tell you should like it and I'm really sorry to disappoint you.

But in the debate Fever vs Coma just keep in mind, that for me Coma was a financial failure. I wasn't celebrating after we released that game. I was scared, defeated and sad.

By buing this game you help us to make step forward. It's not Coma 2, but I promise you, we did our best.
